body_plan: smoke / ghost (skull mask over a round smoke body, smoke trailing below)
material: gas; no fixed volume, no ground contact; edges unstable by definition
volume_rule: volume is NOT preserved - expansion/compression is the material (density and opacity carry it)
rest_shape: canon cutout: mask + body in upper two-thirds, smoke trail in lower third (alpha mean falls 197 -> 42 down the cutout)

idle.description: perpetual drift (slow sine float 6-12px equivalent, rotation +/-2 deg), bottom wisps detach and fade on a 12-16f cycle, outline boil (ragged variants alternating), opacity breathing 100% -> 80% -> 100% over ~32f
idle.secondary_break: a detached puff rises and dissipates every few loops

locomotion.cycle: stretch thin toward travel -> flow with trailing wisps -> re-coalesce with overshoot swell; passing obstacles = split around and rejoin

anticipation: compress and darken (density up, size down) before a burst/scare
settle: expansion puffs x2 decaying, wisps re-form over 8-12f

secondary_chains.behaviour: increasing lag and fade down the chain
lags the smoke slightly - the one semi-solid part, its crack is a protected balance flaw

signature_motions.name: sad-rain-down
signature_motions.note: drifts down, edges raining off, opacity falling

state_map.sleep: settles low, opacity 70%, wisps nearly still
state_map.weakened: dissipation leaks - cannot hold full form

forbidden_motions: a cast shadow with solid edges (shadow, if any, soft and lagging)
smear_drawing: stretched wisp smear on fast flows, 1-2f
sound_linked_motions: cry = density pulse (body darkens/swells on the sound)
